t: Free browser tools for slicing 3D prints and planning CNC and laser cuts.
steps: Open the Grid.Space site in a web browser.
Open Kiri:Moto and load a sample model.
Choose the machine type and slice the model.
Read the Grid.Space documentation and tutorials.
Try Mesh:Tool to edit a model.
Load the page once online, then test it offline.
Check that your printer, CNC, or laser cutter can use the output files.
